newsitem.title: UK: Armed man hijacks London cab after stealing Picasso.
newsitem.headline: Armed man hijacks London cab after stealing Picasso.

text.p: A man armed with a shotgun escaped in a taxi cab after stealing a Picasso painting worth 1 million pounds ($1.6 million) from an exclusive central London art gallery on Thursday, police said.
The thief, described as a white male in his early 30s with sunglasses and a pony-tail, stole the picture, "Tete d'une Femme", from the Lefevre Gallery in London's Mayfair district.
"A man with a shotgun entered the gallery and threatened staff," a police spokesman said.
He then stole the picture, ran out of the gallery pursued by a member of the public and hijacked a passing London taxi.
When his pursuer challenged him, the thief pointed the shotgun out of the taxi window.
Police said they had been contacted by the taxi driver, who would be interviewed by detectives.
